name: Robinhood Agentic Desk
tagline: Watches your Robinhood symbols and drafts each order for your line-by-line sign-off
description: A watching desk for your brokerage account. You set the thresholds, it keeps an eye on the symbols you care about, and when something crosses a line it prepares the exact order it would place. Nothing executes until you have read and approved that specific ticket, and it makes no claim about returns.
author: TheFirstPierre
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
